info.title: Handmade API
info.description: Handmade Art & Crafts Gallery API with Identity, Seller, Notifications, and Catalog.

get.summary: Authorization smoke check for Admin role.

post.summary: Force-logout a user from all sessions immediately.

get.summary: List all notifications, optionally filtered by user and unread state.

post.summary: Create a notification for a user or fan-out to a role, then enqueue delivery.

get.summary: Get any notification by id.

put.summary: Update any notification's content and read state.

get.summary: List seller applications with optional status filter and pagination.
Get a seller application by id.

post.summary: Approve a pending seller application.
Reject a pending seller application.

get.summary: List seller profiles with optional status filter and pagination.
Get a seller profile by id.

post.summary: Suspend an active seller.
Reactivate a suspended seller.
Register a new customer account with email and password.
Login with email and password.
Authenticate with a Google ID token from the SPA.
Rotate refresh token and issue a new access token.
Revoke the supplied refresh token.

get.summary: Return the authenticated user profile.
Get the authenticated user's cart. Returns an empty cart when none exists yet.

delete.summary: Remove every item from the authenticated user's cart. Idempotent if the cart does not exist.

post.summary: Add a product to the cart, or increase quantity if the line already exists.

put.summary: Set the quantity of a cart line identified by product and optional variant.

delete.summary: Remove a cart line identified by product and optional variant.

get.summary: Public active category tree.
Public published products. Sort: newest, priceAsc, priceDesc.
Public published product by slug.

post.summary: Place the authenticated user's cart as one order group (one order per seller).

get.summary: List the authenticated user's persistent notifications (newest first).
Unread count for the authenticated user.
Get one of the authenticated user's notifications.

post.summary: Mark a single notification as read. Idempotent if already read.
Mark every unread notification as read for the authenticated user.

get.summary: List the authenticated customer's order groups, newest first.
Get one of the authenticated customer's order groups with nested seller orders.

post.summary: Cancel one of the authenticated customer's placed seller orders.
Submit a seller application for the authenticated user.

get.summary: List seller applications for the authenticated user.

post.summary: Cancel the authenticated user's own pending application.

get.summary: List orders placed with the current active seller, newest first.
Get one owned order. Unknown or other-seller ids return 404.

post.summary: Confirm an owned placed order.
Mark an owned confirmed order as preparing.
Ship an owned preparing order.
Deliver an owned shipped order.
Cancel an owned placed order.

get.summary: List the current active seller's products.

post.summary: Create a draft product. SellerId and status are server-controlled.

get.summary: Get one owned product including private status and rejection reason.

put.summary: Update an owned draft, rejected, or published product.

delete.summary: Delete a draft or rejected product. Published products must be archived.

post.summary: Submit a draft or rejected product for admin review.
Return a pending product to draft so it can be edited.
Archive a published product (removes it from the public catalog).
Restore an archived product to draft.
Add image metadata. Binary upload uses IFileStorage via POST .../images/upload.
Upload a product image file. Bytes are stored via IFileStorage; PostgreSQL keeps metadata only.

put.summary: Set stock for a product that has no variants. Published listings may be restocked.
Set stock for a variant owned by the current seller.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's seller profile.

put.summary: Update allowed seller profile fields for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Returns a minimal status payload for the v1 API surface.
